seoTitle: Which Gossip Girl Character Are You? Upper East Side Test (10 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Gossip Girl test: 10 everyday questions reveal whether you're Serena, Blair, Dan, Nate, Chuck or Jenny — with your full character breakdown. XOXO.
intro: Are you the queen bee with a plan for everything, the golden girl everyone's talking about, or the outsider watching from the edge? Answer 10 questions about how you really handle friends, rivals and rumours, and find out which Gossip Girl character you are. You know you love me. XOXO.

characters.name: Serena van der Woodsen
characters.title: The Golden It-Girl
characters.summary: Effortless, magnetic and a little bit reckless. Everyone's talking about you — and you just want to live your life.
description: Like Serena, you walk into a room and everyone notices. You don't try — it just happens.
You're a free spirit, and sometimes that gets you into trouble. The show begins with Serena's surprise return to the Upper East Side, with rumours flying about why she left.
Underneath the glamour, you're warm, loyal and trying hard to become a better version of yourself.
characters.flaw: You're impulsive and you run from your problems.
characters.signature: Messy blonde waves, a party invitation and a scandal right behind her.
characters.clashReason: they'd steal your spotlight without even trying

characters.name: Blair Waldorf
characters.title: The Queen Bee Schemer
characters.summary: Ambitious, stylish and always three schemes ahead. You have a plan, a backup plan and a headband to match.
description: Like Blair, you were born to rule. She's the queen bee of the Upper East Side, and she takes the title very seriously.
You're ambitious and you've planned your life down to the details — though life rarely follows the plan.
You can be ruthless, but your loyalty to the people you love is fierce, and nobody schemes better than you.
characters.flaw: You're controlling, and your schemes hurt people you care about.
characters.signature: A perfect headband, a pair of minions and a very elaborate scheme.
characters.clashReason: they'd try to control your every move

characters.name: Dan Humphrey
characters.title: The Outsider Writer
characters.summary: Thoughtful, observant and always on the outside looking in. You write about everyone — and notice more than they think.
description: Like Dan, you're an outsider. He's the Brooklyn kid who never quite fit into the Upper East Side world — and never let anyone forget it.
You're a writer at heart, always observing, always taking notes.
You judge the rich kids, but you secretly want to be part of their world. And you know more of their secrets than anyone suspects.
characters.flaw: You're judgemental, and you're not as innocent as you pretend to be.
characters.signature: A notebook, a flannel shirt and a nickname he hates: Lonely Boy.
characters.clashReason: they'd judge your whole world from the outside

characters.name: Nate Archibald
characters.title: The Golden Boy
characters.summary: Easygoing, good-looking and genuinely kind. Everyone wants something from you — you just want to figure out what you want.
description: Like Nate, you're the golden boy. Good family, good looks, good heart.
Everyone has expectations for you — family, friends, partners — and you spend a lot of time trying to live up to them.
You're more thoughtful than people give you credit for, and you're a genuinely loyal friend.
characters.flaw: You're indecisive and let other people make choices for you.
characters.signature: A lacrosse stick, a big smile and a lot of people wanting something from him.
characters.clashReason: they'd go along with whatever's easiest

characters.name: Chuck Bass
characters.title: The Dark Charmer
characters.summary: Rich, scheming and impossible to ignore. You act like you don't care about anything — except the one thing you'd lose everything for.
description: Like Chuck, you've got style, money and a reputation. You introduce yourself the way Chuck does: "I'm Chuck Bass."
You're a schemer and a businessman. Chuck built his own empire — literally, his hotel is called The Empire.
Behind the darkness, you love deeply. Chuck's love for Blair is one of the great TV love stories.
characters.flaw: You hide pain behind bad behaviour, and you can be cruel.
characters.signature: A scarf, a tumbler of scotch and "I'm Chuck Bass."
characters.clashReason: they'd see right through your act — and use it

characters.name: Jenny Humphrey
characters.title: The Ambitious Upstart
characters.summary: Creative, determined and willing to do almost anything to be accepted. You're a designer with big dreams.
description: Like Jenny, you're talented. She's an aspiring fashion designer who makes her own clothes and dreams big.
You want in. Jenny worked hard to climb the Upper East Side social ladder — and became Queen herself for a while.
Your ambition can take you to dark places, but you're creative, brave and more resilient than people think.
characters.flaw: You'll change who you are to fit in.
characters.signature: A sewing machine, heavy eyeliner and a dress she made herself.
characters.clashReason: they'd climb over you to get to the top

questions.text: Your friends are planning a weekend away. You...

options.text: Make the itinerary. Colour-coded
Say yes to everything and book nothing
Go along for the beach and the company
Find an excuse to stay home. Not really your crowd

questions.text: Someone gets the promotion you wanted. You...

options.text: Congratulate them sweetly. Then start plotting
Say you're happy for them, then complain about it all night
Work twice as hard and take it from them
Act like you never wanted it anyway
Sketch designs in your room
Brunch that somehow turns into a road trip
Write in a coffee shop
Get out on the water with friends

questions.text: You like someone, and they like you back — but it's complicated. You...

options.text: Act like you don't care. Saying it out loud is terrifying
Go for it and deal with the fallout later
Play hard to get. They'll have to earn you
Stay just friends, and quietly hope for years

questions.text: Your parents have big expectations for your future. You...

options.text: Try to live up to them, even though it's not what you want
Exceed them. Obviously
Ignore them. You'll make your own name
Do the opposite, just to make a point

questions.text: You're choosing where to eat tonight. You pick...

options.text: A place nobody's heard of yet
Wherever the party is
The most exclusive place in town. You know the owner
Somewhere new and trendy. You want to be seen

questions.text: A friend is going through a really hard time. You...

options.text: Show up and take over: food, playlist, pep talk
Drop everything and stay the night
Listen, and just be there
Skip the words. Make a grand gesture instead

questions.text: You hear a juicy rumour about someone you know. You...

options.text: Warn them. You know what it's like to be the rumour
Use it. Strategically
Quietly judge everyone involved
Stay out of it. You hate drama

questions.text: You're invited to the party of the year. Your best friend isn't. You...

options.text: Sneak them in the back door
Don't go. Friends come first
Finally, your chance to be in the room. You're going
Go, then tell them it was boring. It wasn't

questions.text: You find out your best friend slept with your partner behind your back — and the whole school is about to find out. You...

options.text: Get your version out first. You control the story
Forgive them eventually. You've made mistakes too
Act like it doesn't hurt — then reinvent yourself completely
Pretend you're above it all. You're not
